name: k8s node CPU saturation — a cluster node under 10% idle for 15 min
description: Fires, per host.name, when AVG(system.cpu.utilization) for state=idle across the node's CPUs over the trailing 15 min is below 0.10 — the node has been at least 90% busy for 15 minutes. Busy is read as 1 - idle from hostmetrics, not from load average (.ai/ci-node-capacity-reads.md). Grouped by host.name over the three k3s nodes. Emitter: the per-node host collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector), converged by ansible/ci-pool.yml. Runbook: open the 'Kubernetes node load' board; ssh <node>; mpstat 5 3; free -g; kubectl describe node <node>; kubectl get pods -A -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=<node>. Plan kubernetes-node-observability (livespec-dev-tooling-dfdiil), item livespec-dev-tooling-uftb4o.
